# Pixeldesk

> Pixeldesk is an all-in-one project management platform for agencies, product teams, and consultancies. It combines sprint planning, client portals, budget tracking, timesheets, notice board, and team chat in one workspace.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.pixeldesk.in/): Project management software overview
- [Features](https://www.pixeldesk.in/features): Dashboard, projects, sprints, client portal, timesheets, chat, and people management
- [Pricing](https://www.pixeldesk.in/pricing): Free Starter plan and paid Growth/Enterprise plans
- [Help Center](https://www.pixeldesk.in/resources): Guides, tutorials, and FAQs
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.pixeldesk.in/resources/knowledge-base): Feature documentation and setup guides
- [Blog](https://www.pixeldesk.in/blogs): Project management guides and industry insights

## Product summary

Pixeldesk helps project managers, delivery teams, and clients work in one workspace with live client visibility, agile sprint planning, integrated timesheets, leave management, and project-linked team chat.
